independentLayers.description: Reference numbers for the list, tabs and indicator of both variants.

intent: Switch between peer panels that share one area, from a list naming each

properties.description: The active tab value (a tab or panel value attribute, else its index). Setting it switches panels without a change event.
The first active tab, applied once at connect when no value attribute is present; default: the first enabled tab.
horizontal (default) or vertical: the list direction, the indicator edge and which arrow keys move focus.
segmented (default): a composite list with a raised indicator; underline: tabs over a thin track with a 0.5u bar.
Arrow-key focus also activates the tab (automatic activation); otherwise Enter, Space or a press does.
Accessible name of the tablist (aria-label on the list part).

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: Sets the unit u (px) for this element and its subtree: one of the SIZES steps 2…12 (data-size is the same input). Lengths scale from u; type follows 10px + u.

events.name: change
events.trigger: a press, Enter or Space (or focus, with activate-on-focus) activates another enabled tab; preventDefault keeps the current tab

semantics.role: none (the list is role=tablist, each tab role=tab, each panel role=tabpanel)

keyboard.keys: ArrowRight, ArrowLeft (mirrored in RTL; ArrowDown, ArrowUp when vertical)
keyboard.action: move focus to the next / previous enabled tab, wrapping; activate it with activate-on-focus
move focus to the first / last enabled tab

content.children: A [data-part=list] of [data-part=tab] children (an optional [data-part=indicator] is generated when absent) and [data-part=panel] children, matched by their value attributes (else by index). Preset: panels alone, each with a label attribute; the list is generated.

constraints: Each tab's value names a panel with the same value; a tab without a panel has no aria-controls.
Inactive panels stay in the DOM, hidden (data-hidden); every panel is a tab stop (tabindex 0).

The indicator is placed by --active-tab-left / -top / -right / -bottom / -width / -height (px, set by script after layout and on resize); it does not move before the first change (data-activation-direction=none).
Setting value from script changes the active tab without a change event.

avoidWhen.when: Choosing a value for a form or a setting.
avoidWhen.reason: A tab switches content and submits nothing; a segmented control is a form-associated choice.

avoidWhen.when: Sections the user may want to see together or in sequence.
avoidWhen.reason: Tabs show one panel at a time; an accordion lets several be open.
Tabs swap panels in place; navigation needs links (the kit has no navigation component yet).

nodes.summary: The tablist (role=tablist, aria-orientation; data-orientation, data-activation-direction). Base UI Tabs.List.
One tab (role=tab, aria-selected, aria-controls; data-active, data-disabled), the construction pattern inside; the active tab is the list's tab stop. Base UI Tabs.Tab.
The active tab's marker, placed by the --active-tab-* variables: a raised fill under the tab (segmented) or a 0.5u bar on the track (underline). Base UI Tabs.Indicator.
A tabpanel (aria-labelledby its tab, tabindex 0), hidden and data-hidden while its tab is inactive. Base UI Tabs.Panel.
